mapper.select: SELECT streamer_id, platform_account_id FROM broadcast_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId}

INSERT INTO viewer_profiles (platform_account_id, viewer_hash, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) VALUES
(#{platformAccountId}, #{row.viewerHash}, #{row.firstSeenAt}, #{row.lastSeenAt})
ON CONFLICT (platform_account_id, viewer_hash) DO UPDATE SET first_seen_at = LEAST(viewer_profiles.first_seen_at, EXCLUDED.first_seen_at), last_seen_at = GREATEST(viewer_profiles.last_seen_at, EXCLUDED.last_seen_at) RETURNING id AS viewer_id, viewer_hash
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO chat_messages (session_id, viewer_id, message, sent_at) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, #{item.viewerId}, #{item.message}, #{item.sentAt})

INSERT INTO viewer_metrics (session_id, measured_at, viewer_count) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, #{item.measuredAt}, #{item.viewerCount})
ON CONFLICT (session_id, measured_at) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO collection_gaps (session_id, started_at, ended_at, reason) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{gap.startedAt}, #{gap.endedAt}, #{gap.reason}) ON CONFLICT (session_id, started_at) DO UPDATE SET ended_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ended_at, collection_gaps.ended_at)
